in this dialog when viewing chages a task made in the review column, we want to add an option to discard a specific file. in this instance, we dont want to push the CSS file.

suggestedTask.title: Add ability to discard individual files from review dialog
suggestedTask.description: Add functionality to selectively discard specific files when reviewing task changes in the human_review column. This allows users to exclude unwanted files (like CSS changes) before merging/staging. Implementation includes: (1) New IPC handler for discarding individual files using git restore, (2) Update DiffViewDialog to show discard buttons per file, (3) Add confirmation and success feedback, (4) Refresh diff view after discarding files.
